findings.title: GetSortedTiers silently ignores contradictory self-loop edges unlike IsTotalOrder/IsValidOrder
findings.rule_violated: Defense in depth — contradictory equivalence-class self-loop must be rejected uniformly across all analysis methods
findings.remediation: Change line 264 to `if (u == v) throw new InvalidOperationException(...)` or add a boolean output parameter to signal validity. At minimum, match the `return false` behavior of the other two methods.

findings.title: Three methods contain 100% duplicated Kahn's Algorithm logic with only minor behavioral differences
findings.rule_violated: DRY — algorithm must be defined once and composed; duplicate implementations create divergent-fix risk
findings.remediation: Extract a private method (e.g., TryBuildTopologicalOrder) returning the order list or null on cycle. IsValidOrder wraps it checking for non-null. IsTotalOrder additionally verifies uniqueness via the single-source BFS property. GetSortedTiers groups the resulting order into tiers.

findings.title: UnionFind implementation lacks union-by-rank/size for optimal complexity
findings.rule_violated: Union-Find textbook optimality requires both path compression and union-by-rank to achieve O(alpha(n)) amortized; missing union-by-rank limits to O(log n)
findings.remediation: Add a private Dictionary<string, int> _rank field. In Union, attach the smaller-rank tree under the larger-rank root, incrementing rank when equal.

findings.title: Theoretical division-by-zero in BradleyTerry denominator for crafted zero-gamma entries
findings.rule_violated: Robustness — numeric algorithms must guard against division-by-zero even in edge cases only reachable through crafted input
findings.remediation: Add a guard: if (gamma[i] + gamma[j] < 1e-12) continue; inside the inner loop at line 69.

findings.title: Partition bridge node count can evaluate to zero at small overlap rates, breaking connectivity guarantee
findings.rule_violated: Invariant from README — partitioning must ensure statistical connectivity; zero bridge nodes violates this guarantee
findings.remediation: Enforce a minimum: int bCount = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Round(n * overlapRate)) when kPartitions > 1 and n > 0. Alternatively validate overlapRate * n >= kPartitions - 1 before proceeding.
